text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuania's parliamentary group to support Tibet said on Wednesday that big states should not wash their hands of the execution of smaller nations.
- The social insurance department in the port town of Klaipeda found that around 500 sailors in 20 shipping companies pay no social insurance taxes and have no social guarantees.
- The trial of the former editor-in-chief of Lietuvos Aidas daily Saulius Stoma, accused of illegal property dealings, was postponed for three months.
- New Vilnius mayor Rolandas Paksas said he will hold news conferences every Wednesday to provide information about the developments in the capital.
